listing.name: GoFaceless
listing.short_description: Plan, create, review, and refine durable AI video sessions.
listing.long_description: Use GoFaceless from ChatGPT or Codex to plan a supervised video, attach references, review storyboards and candidates, make scene-level revisions, approve exact production steps, render previews, undo changes, and continue the same durable session in the native GoFaceless editor.

starter_prompts: Show my latest GoFaceless video sessions and explain which one needs my attention.
Create a supervised 30-second faceless video and show me the plan before any paid generation.
Use this reference to guide the visual style of my GoFaceless video without copying protected branding.
Change only the weakest scene in this GoFaceless session and preserve everything I already accepted.
Review the current candidate and quality result, then tell me the safest next action.
release_notes: Initial app-plus-skill submission. GoFaceless exposes a supervised, durable video-session workflow over a hosted OAuth MCP server. It does not publish to social networks, purchase credits, or bypass GoFaceless approval, organization, entitlement, quality, or delivery gates.
